id.description: Catalog path, prefixed m/: manufacturer slug/first year/model slug

type_detail.description: Tadpole: a three-wheeler with two wheels in front rather than behind; bench_seat: a moped-style bike; seated: an e-scooter; self_balancing_scooter: side-by-side wheels steered by a bar; step_through: a frame with a low or no top tube

stock_photo.description: Bikebook-hosted copy of the manufacturer's product photo

final_year.description: Last year the model was still offered (latest snapshot year); nil while still current

years.url_live.description: Whether the manufacturer's page is still up; false for an archive capture, which shows it as it was

frame.material_detail.description: The manufacturer's name for its material or grade, e.g. Reynolds 853 steel or FACT 11m carbon

frame.folding.description: Half_fold: one hinge mid-frame, the halves side by side; triangle_fold: the rear triangle swings under (Brompton); umbrella_fold: collapses lengthwise to stand upright (Strida); stem_fold: only the handlebar stem folds, onto the deck; couplers: the frame separates into pieces

frame.mounts.location.description: Downtube, under_downtube, seat_tube, top_tube, under_top_tube, fork_legs; a type's repeated place takes _2, _3…

frame.mounts.holes.description: Bolt holes, when not the usual 2 (3 for a three-pack cage)

frame.cable_routing.description: Dropper: only the dropper post's cable runs inside the frame; internal: through ports in the frame; stealth: through the headset or stem

frame.bottom_bracket.shell.description: E.g. BSA, T47, BB92 or threaded

frame.bottom_bracket.spindle.description: E.g. square taper, DUB, GXP or 24mm

frame.headset.description: SHIS, upper | lower, e.g. ZS44/28.6 | ZS56/40 or EC34/28.6-26tpi | EC34/30 H13.7

frame.front_derailleur_mount.description: E.g. braze-on, direct mount or none

frame.derailleur_hanger.description: E.g. SRAM UDH or the manufacturer's part number

frame.max_fork_travel.description: The longest fork the frame is rated for, suspension or not, in millimeters

frame.coil_compatible.description: The frame takes a coil rear shock

frame.max_weight_total.description: Vehicle weight limit: rider and cargo, in kilograms

frame.gross_weight_rating.description: Vehicle plus max weight, the total combined limit (curb_weight, GVWR), in kilograms

wheels.configured.description: False for a wheel the frame takes that the complete build doesn't come with

wheels.axle_standard.description: E.g. Syntace X-12, Kabolt or Deadbolt

wheels.cassette_interface.description: The freehub or driver body a rear wheel's cassette mounts on; hg_road is Shimano's 11/12-speed road body

wheels.max_tire_width.description: Widest tire the frame or fork clears at this bsd, in millimeters

groupset.electronic.description: Shifts electronically (Di2, AXS, eTap, EPS, wireless)

brakes.anti_lock.description: An anti-lock braking system (ABS) works this brake

motors.spindle.description: A mid drive's crank interface, e.g. ISIS

motors.rated_power.description: Continuous/nominal, basis for legal class, in watts

motors.operating_modes.availability.description: How the buyer gets the mode: stock; upgrade, a mode the maker sells at extra cost, picked at purchase in place of the stock one or bought and fitted later; app_update, an unlock; aftermarket, a third party's

cargo.type.description: Load-area form: Tail types sit behind the rider; Front Box is a walled front load area, Front Platform a flat sideless front deck

cargo.volume.description: A box's or bin's capacity, in liters

sizes.geometry.seat_tube_ctc.description: Seat Tube C to C, in millimeters

sizes.geometry.travel_front.description: Fork travel at this size, when it varies by size, in millimeters

sizes.geometry.travel_rear.description: Rear wheel travel at this size, when it varies by size, in millimeters

sizes.geometry.total_weight.description: Total vehicle weight at this size, in kilograms

sizes.geometry.extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical measurements, gathered on coerce; another unit only where the key names it, in millimeters

components.dimensions.diameter.description: Clamp diameter for bars, stems and seatposts; bead seat diameter for rims, tires and wheels, in millimeters

components.dimensions.travel.description: A fork's or shock's travel; how far a dropper or telescoping seatpost adjusts, in millimeters

components.dimensions.offset.description: Rake on forks; setback on seatposts, in millimeters

components.dimensions.extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical dimensions, gathered on coerce, in millimeters

components.angles.angle.description: The component's own angle, e.g. a stem's rise, in degrees

components.angles.extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical angles, gathered on coerce, in degrees
